observed: The app package was a files-only payload, so a thin hand-written page and a complete window were signed the same way. The IDE shipped with no status region, browser-default scrollbars (the family scrollbar rule lived only in toast.css) and a body painted from the raw published deep role, which turned a saturated palette into a full-window colour wash.
correction: The signed payload is now a popit.app/2 authored manifest (kind, entry, title, summary, pages, adds, regions, derives). verify() refuses a files-only payload as app-legacy, an incomplete manifest as app-not-authored, and a page missing bar/status/body/foot as app-window-incomplete. The window ground is derived from the published deep role by package.js (hue kept, light capped) and written to --popit-ground; contour-theme.css paints html and every scrollbar from it, so no app shows a platform scrollbar.
